top_story.headline: A quiet Wednesday: no logged contacts with the President or cabinet, no new disclosures
top_story.dek: Nothing in this window rises to a lead story.
paragraphs: The scan of FARA filings found no communication with the President, the Vice President or a cabinet-level official. The two flagged filings from Friends of Sinn Fein, Inc. only quote public statements about President Donald Trump's remarks on Irish unity.

No new House or Senate financial disclosures, FARA registrations or documents, or Office of Government Ethics filings turned up in the window. The lobbying feed was dominated by routine third-quarter reports, with 15 new registrations and 37 terminations (see the LDA section).

sections.eyebrow: Contacts With the President, VP & Cabinet
sections.headline: No logged contacts with the President, VP or cabinet; two lobbying reports name the President
paragraphs: The two FARA informational-materials filings by Friends of Sinn Fein, Inc. (foreign principal Sinn Fein, Ireland) quote press coverage and statements from Irish-American groups about President Donald Trump's public comments on a united Ireland. They do not log any contact with him, so they are not reported as communications.
Two third-quarter lobbying reports name the President:

items: National Affordable Housing Management Association (NAHMA) (in-house): flagged as naming President Donald Trump. The lobbying text captured covers H.R. 8626, the Workforce Housing Tax Credit Act, and the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (Public Law 119-21). Filing.

Air-Conditioning, Heating, and Refrigeration Institute (in-house): lists the President among the entities lobbied. Topics include climate policy, heat pumps, PFAS and the H.R. 8016 / S. 4153 Forever Chemical Regulation and Accountability Act of 2026, refrigerants and HFCs under the AIM Act, and ENERGY STAR. Filing.

sections.headline: No new ethics filings this window
paragraphs: Seven Office of Government Ethics filings were reviewed for the October 11–14 window. None were flagged for divestitures, terminations, or pending dispositions, and all routine filings had already been reported in prior runs.

sections.headline: 15 new registrations and 37 terminations, mostly routine
paragraphs: The lobbying feed for October 13 onward lists 750 filings, but the fetch stopped after 30 pages, so the rest are not counted: 607 third-quarter reports, 78 third-quarter no-activity reports, 17 third-quarter no-activity terminations, 16 third-quarter terminations, 15 registrations, 6 third-quarter amendments, 3 second-quarter terminations, 3 second-quarter amendments, and 1 each of first-quarter amendment, fourth-quarter amendment, fourth-quarter termination amendment, second-quarter no-activity report and second-quarter report.

Standouts: Groisman LLC registered for Apollo Power America, Inc., with the foreign entities Solarpaint Ltd. and Apollo Power Ltd. listed, to lobby on Section 232 tariff treatment of Israeli-origin polysilicon products. Cornerstone Government Affairs, Inc. registered for Welltower Inc. with Andrew Flick, a former special assistant to the President and senior adviser in the Office of the Vice President, listed as a covered position. Red Door Consulting, LLC reports covered position Scott Centorino (Special Assistant to the President for Domestic Policy) on several clients. The largest spender seen was the Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association at $1.81 million in expenses.

The table covers all registrations and terminations. The 255 activity reports with a signal are mostly left out: the remaining reports in the window are routine quarterly filings, and the notable ones are noted below the table.

H4 Advisors reports lobbying for Emirates Airline, a foreign carrier (L139). Smooth Stone Strategies reports lobbying on 'connections with White House and Department of War entities' for Guardian Resources/Willowstick Technologies (L309). Horizons Global Solutions lists Stephen Boyd, described as Assistant Attorney General at the Department of Justice, as a covered position on many defense and health clients. Poblete Tamargo, LLP filed several dozen reports for individuals and families with Cuba-claims matters. Most other quarterly reports in the window are routine.
